name: ESO 593-IG008 (Hubble)
blurb: ESO 593-IG008, a luminous infrared galaxy system nicknamed The Bird, seen by Hubble.
label: eso593ig008-hubble
story: Two massive spiral galaxies and a smaller irregular galaxy are merging here into a shape astronomers call The Bird. Its head, the irregular galaxy, is forming stars violently.

claims.text: ESO 593-IG 008 is also known as IRAS 19115-2124
Astronomers dubbed the system 'The Bird'; it also resembles a cosmic Tinker Bell
It is composed of two massive spiral galaxies and a third irregular galaxy
It belongs to the family of luminous infrared galaxies
The 'head' (the irregular galaxy) is forming stars violently
ESO593-IG008 is a target of the HST ACS survey of luminous infrared galaxies (program 10592)
